title: Looking at the finger placement
description: The position of the hand can be rotated and matched against a clear diagram.

blocks.text: A flat picture doesn’t always explain which finger is covering a string and where the barre begins.

quote.text: The app is a little slow and disjointed but the concept is excellent and being able to rotate the image and look at the guitars fingers has been an excellent help.

blocks.text: Tie the rotatable model to the diagram and to a short real example. Highlight one finger at a time, keeping the rest visible.
The model has to match a fingering that has been checked, not merely look plausible.
